name: Infinite Shield heals on damage taken and loses a charge (#11043)
contract: Infinite Shield 520457 tooltip: 'Shield an ally with 10 charges ... Each time they take damage, they will be healed for 190 + 25% SP and lose 1 charge. Can only occur once per sec.' The record has ProcFlags 0, so without a spell_proc row the aura never procs. Injure Self 19806 is a 70 damage self hit. The heal 520458 has base 189 + 1 die side = 190 and the 0.25 spell power coefficient from the tooltip. Two identical Chronomancers differ only in spell power (0 and 1000) with every heal forced critical by crit rating, so the heal totals are base * m * c and (base + 0.25 * 1000) * m * c for the same class multiplier m and critical multiplier c; their ratio is 440 / 190 = 2.3158 whatever m and c are, which a 0.28 coefficient (2.4737) or a missing coefficient (1.0) cannot satisfy. Each proc must cast exactly one heal and spend exactly one of the 10 charges; a second hit inside the same second must neither heal again nor spend a charge, and a hit after the cooldown must. Health regeneration is off so only the heal log is read.

steps.label: Infinite Shield is applied to the plain Chronomancer
Infinite Shield is applied to the strong Chronomancer
Infinite Shield starts with ten charges
The first hit casts one heal
The strong Chronomancer's first hit casts one heal
The heal is critical as forced
Take 70 damage again within the second
The cooldown suppresses a second heal
The cooldown suppresses a second charge loss
The next proc casts a second heal
The next proc spends another charge
